description: This file defines the PollingState interface which specifies methods related to managing and querying polling states in an ECU communication context for the RomRaider project.

classes.name: PollingState
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for managing polling state information such as current and last states, query states, and polling speed flags.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current polling state as an integer.

methods.name: setCurrentState
methods.description: Sets the current polling state to the specified integer.

methods.name: getLastState
methods.description: Returns the last polling state as an integer.

methods.name: setLastState
methods.description: Updates the last polling state with the provided integer.

methods.name: isNewQuery
methods.description: Checks if the current query is a new one, returning a boolean.

methods.name: setNewQuery
methods.description: Sets the new query flag to the specified boolean value.

methods.name: isLastQuery
methods.description: Checks if the last query was made, returning a boolean.

methods.name: setLastQuery
methods.description: Sets the last query flag to the specified boolean value.

methods.name: isFastPoll
methods.description: Checks if the polling is in fast mode, returning a boolean.

methods.name: setFastPoll
methods.description: Sets the fast poll flag to the specified boolean value.
